newsitem.title: UK: UK's Ashquay buys Warner property.
newsitem.headline: UK's Ashquay buys Warner property.

text.p: British property investment and development company Ashquay Group Plc on Thursday said it had agreed to buy a property portfolio from Warner Estate Holdings Plc for an initial 12.3 million stg.
Ashquay said the portfolio comprised 21 retail properties in the UK valued on an open market basis at 12.7 million stg, and had a current annual income of 1.2 million stg.

Under the terms of the acquisition, Ashquay said it would pay 10.8 million stg in cash on completion of new group borrowing facilities, with the remaining 1.5 million to be satisfied by issuing 5.4 million new Ashquay shares at 28p each.
A further 1.0 million stg would be payable on the second anniversary of the completion, it added.

"This acquisition is in line with our stated objectives of building a balanced portfolio of properties providing long-term capital and income growth within the United Kingdom," Ashquay's chairman Derek Tughan said in a statement.
